verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API is described by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document ("Fellow Developer API" v1.0.2, paths under /api/v1/). This is the ReadMe registry document behind the developers.fellow.ai reference. The probe's 404s on guessed Fellow-branded paths do not contradict this, because the spec is served from ReadMe's api-registry endpoint. Missing for 10: a Fellow-branded or conventional discoverable spec URL (openapi.json/swagger.json paths return 404), an API changelog or deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of the download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
